VulnerabilityRecord.description: Langchain before 0.0.247 allows arbitrary code execution via the SQLDatabaseChain chain due to improper input sanitization. The vulnerable chain constructs and executes SQL queries using unsanitized user input, enabling SQL injection and subsequent OS command execution.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade langchain to version 0.0.247 or later

VulnerabilityRecord.description: joblib before 1.2.0 allows arbitrary code execution via deserialization of pickle-serialized objects in the parallel processing workflow. An attacker who can control pickled inputs passed to Parallel() can achieve arbitrary code execution on the machine running joblib.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade joblib to version 1.2.0 or later; note scikit-learn 0.24.1 may need to be upgraded to 1.0+ to accept joblib 1.2.0
VulnerabilityRecord._notes: TRANSITIVE dependency: joblib 0.14.1 is pulled in by scikit-learn 0.24.1 — real version from requirements.txt; affected range < 1.2.0

VulnerabilityRecord.description: A Buffer Overflow vulnerability exists in NumPy versions 1.9.x through 1.22.x via PyArray_NewLikeArrayWithShape in ctors.c. Processing a specially crafted array can trigger a heap buffer overflow, causing a denial of service.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade numpy to version 1.22.2 or later

VulnerabilityRecord.description: A use-after-free vulnerability in SciPy versions before 1.11.0 in the Cython-compiled sparse array routines. Triggers when a sparse matrix object is freed while a reference to its internal data buffer is still held, causing a segmentation fault or denial of service.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade scipy to version 1.11.0 or later

VulnerabilityRecord.description: Requests before 2.31.0 allows unintended credential leakage via the Proxy-Authorization header. When following a redirect from an HTTPS URL to an HTTP URL, the Proxy-Authorization header is forwarded to the destination HTTP server, potentially exposing proxy credentials.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade requests to version 2.31.0 or later

VulnerabilityRecord.description: An issue was discovered in lxml before 4.7.1. lxml/html/clean.py allows XSS (stored and reflected) via the formaction attribute. A cleaned HTML document can contain javascript: URIs in formaction attribute values on button elements, enabling cross-site scripting attacks.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade lxml to version 4.7.1 or later

VulnerabilityRecord.description: Pillow before 10.0.0 allows a denial of service via ImageFont.getbbox or ImageFont.getlength when called with a crafted argument containing many characters. An attacker can trigger uncontrolled resource consumption, causing the process to hang or exhaust available memory.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade Pillow to version 10.0.0 or later
VulnerabilityRecord._notes: CVE-2021-27922 was fixed in 8.3.0 — Pillow 9.0.1 is not affected. Replaced with CVE-2023-44271 which affects Pillow < 10.0.0

VulnerabilityRecord.description: TensorFlow before 2.9.0 allows code injection via tf.raw_ops.DrawBoundingBoxes. An attacker can exploit improper validation of graph node attributes to achieve arbitrary code execution in the TensorFlow runtime environment.
VulnerabilityRecord.remediation_recommendation: Upgrade tensorflow to version 2.9.0 or later
VulnerabilityRecord._notes: Real version from requirements.txt: tensorflow==1.15.5; affected range < 2.9.0

RemediationEngine.breaking_change_notes: langchain 0.0.247+ introduced significant API changes. Review LANGCHAIN_MIGRATE.md for chain and agent migration.
joblib 0.14.1 → 1.2.0 is a major version jump; scikit-learn must also be upgraded from 0.24.1 to >= 1.0 to be compatible with joblib 1.2.0.
numpy 1.22.2 is a patch release with no breaking API changes from 1.22.0.
scipy 1.11 removed several deprecated functions. Run scipy migration checker before upgrading in production.
requests 2.31.0 is backward-compatible. No breaking API changes from 2.27.x.
lxml 4.7.x is backward-compatible with 4.6.x. HTML cleaner behavior may differ for edge-case inputs.
Pillow 10.0.0 removed several deprecated APIs (ANTIALIAS constant renamed to LANCZOS, etc.). Review Pillow migration guide before upgrading from 9.x.
tensorflow 1.x → 2.x is a major version change requiring migration of Session-based code to Eager execution and updating all TF1 APIs. Use tf.compat.v1 shims as an interim step.
